dateline: BTS arrived in Lima for their first-ever Peru visit, with three ARIRANG World Tour shows at Estadio San Marcos (Oct 7, 9, 10) after two sold-out nights in Bogotá.
heroHeadline: Day 4,866: BTS in Lima for Peru Debut
heroSubtitle: October 9, 2026 is Day 4,866 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. Following two sold-out Bogotá nights (Oct 2-3), the ARIRANG World Tour plays Lima's Estadio San Marcos, with Santiago, Buenos Aires and São Paulo to follow.
